subject: Preflight: Hands-on Sprint — room booking, visitor access & streaming policy
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martinez <olivia@finpulse.com>, ops@finpulse.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: Hands-on Sprint — room booking, visitor access & streaming policy

Hi Olivia / FinPulse ops,

Following up on next week's hands-on sprint. We're preparing the room layout, AV plan, and a short preflight so we can run the routing & load tests without surprises. Proposed checklist: 
- Arrival / visitor badges (security desk window at 8:30)
- Screen-sharing & recording permissions (one-way streaming to your guests only)
- 09:30–11:00 prompt review & routing test (5 sessions, 6 clients each)
- 14:00–15:30 controlled load test (simulated steady traffic + burst)

Can you confirm: preferred room (onsite conf A vs B), whether external guests need NDA or explicit recording consent, and any limits on headcount? Attached: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf and Visitor_Access_Form.docx — please have your ops contact pre-fill if possible.

If the onsite window is tight we can run the prompt review virtually and keep the load test on-prem. Marcus and Hannah are on copy to coordinate AV and routing profiles.

Thanks,
Logan

--
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Olivia Martinez <olivia@finpulse.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@finpulse.com, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight: Hands-on Sprint — room booking, visitor access & streaming policy

Logan — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of constraints from our side: 
- Room: Conf A is already reserved for an internal all-hands. Can we use Conf B (capacity 28) or the adjacent lab? Conf B is preferred for AV wiring.
- Headcount: we can accommodate 18 external attendees onsite; rest will dial in.
- Recording: our security team requires explicit consent from each external attendee to be recorded/streamed; one-way streaming to a private YouTube link is OK if we get signed consent.
- Visitor passes: all external guests need to submit a photo ID 48h before arrival (ops@finpulse.com will collect).

We can shift the prompt review to 10:00–11:30 and push the load test to 15:00–16:00 if that helps. Also adding our security lead, Priya Singh (priya.singh@finpulse.com) for the visitor agreement — I'll loop her into ops.

Olivia
Director, Platform Partnerships
FinPulse

--

Action items for Redwood ops: 
- I'll bring two load generators (local VMs) and validate time-sync before 14:30.
- Hannah: can you confirm which prompts we should reserve for the routing smoke-tests? I suggested 6 customer personas in the agenda; happy to tighten.

Olivia: for the signed consent, do you have a template we should use, or do you want us to send Redwood's standard recording consent form? We'll need the final visitor list by EOD Wednesday to pre-print badges.

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight: Hands-on Sprint — room booking, visitor access & streaming policy

Marcus / Logan — attaching the visitor agreement template (Signed_Visitor_Agreement.pdf). Priya's security team confirmed the following: 
- All external attendees must sign the agreement and provide a government ID 48h before arrival.
- Recording policy: one-way stream only, archived for 7 days. Any longer retention requires written approval from FinPulse Legal.
- No recording of screen share that includes internal FinPulse customer data; please ensure demo data is synthetic or redacted.

We can accept Redwood's recording consent if you add the clause about temporary retention. I'll have ops@finpulse.com collect the IDs and the signed forms — they will send a consolidated packet by Thursday 10:00.

Olivia

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the signed agreement, Olivia — received Signed_Visitor_Agreement.pdf from Priya's team. Final confirmations below: 
- Room: Conf B reserved for 2026-07-20 (09:45–16:30)
- Prompt review: 10:00–11:30 (we'll run 6 personas, 5-minute warmups each)
- Load test: 15:00–16:00 (steady 160 req/min with two 1-min bursts at 320 req/min)
- Recording: one-way private stream; Redwood will limit retention to 7 days in the stream metadata and not record any FinPulse customer data.
- Visitor list & IDs: Final packet expected Thu 10:00 (per ops).

Attachments: LoadTestChecklist.xlsx (routing profiles, target SLOs, and kill-switch steps). Marcus — can you take the first run and validate the KV cache warmup? Hannah — please prepare the prompt set and share in the Drive folder so we can lock versions.

I'll send the calendar invite with the updated times and join info. See you all next week.

Best,
Logan
